lines.text: Zerubbabel, Joshua the high priest, and all the remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the LORD their God.
They obeyed Haggai's words because the LORD their God had sent him, so the people feared the LORD.
Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, told the people, "I am with you," declares the LORD.
The LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel, governor of Israel, and of Joshua and all the remnant, and they began the work.
They began on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Cyrus.
